review_brief:
# Review return: two native parametric builds

Assignment `review-b291f7a1cb82f6ca`; both assigned targets are reviewer-ready and owner-pending.
`25d47dde0246` keeps generator SHA-256 `a0982b27...e356d` and exact canonical program SHA-256 `6d7bd780...053bd`.
Its new `boundary_fill` variant crops first, then fills only zero components exposed to the new crop boundary; the protected wrong-order witness changes the result.
`be05cee2806f` repairs the production generator to SHA-256 `27f3f462...82202` while preserving canonical program SHA-256 `28a25eb2...d093`.
Its new `activated_neighbors` variant absorbs eligible zero components first, then uses only newly absorbed cells to activate adjacent colors; the protected wrong-intermediate witness changes the result.
Fresh staged tests pass: 42/42 and 18/18. Each bounded audit covers 32 seeds, 8,320 labeled pairs, 320 causal separations, 640 rival rejections, 40 protected family labels, and 20 protected counterfactual labels.
Each target also has a passing authoring preflight, source-bound manifest, protected causal replay, 16 verified one-query public views, four first-turn checks, 24 private-field invariance mutations, and four positive controls.

## 25d47dde0246 — exact-default prototype

The existing generator already implements the canonical joint-nonzero bounding-box crop and retains its earlier disconnected-object teaching repair, so production source was not changed. The family adds `followup=canonical|boundary_fill` on matched inputs. Generated scenes contain both boundary-connected zeros and enclosed holes, vary geometry across seeds, and include lawful substantive 30×30 coverage. The canonical setting is byte-for-byte the selected Racket authority; cyan (`8`) is reserved for Stage B only.

Self-review tested demo/query boundaries, stable prefixes, setting identification, duplicate inputs, public/private separation, wrong-order causality, and plausible crop/fill rivals. No finding survived the finite 32-seed audit. Manifest SHA-256: `945b93db288f8861e85a2089acc959505c25e1940059d3d28abb8ba1e23a1d50`.

previous_catalog_record.summary: Dense field of all 10 colors; rule recolors each 0-region that touches a color-1 cell to 1 (isolated 0-regions stay 0).

scope: Accepted generator repair; finite reviewer evidence, no new maintainer execution

sequential_dependency.intermediate: Compare input and Stage A to identify exactly the cells newly changed from 0 to 1, while retaining the zero components that Stage A preserved.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Execute the exact canonical rule: absorb every zero component touching an original color-1 cell.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Recolor original nonzero, non-1 cells cardinally adjacent to the newly absorbed cells to color 1.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: The Stage-B activator set does not exist in the input. Substituting original 1-cells activates different colored neighbors and changes the final answer.
